# CloudForShare — by Irfanz Solutions

> CloudForShare is a free, fast, and secure file-sharing platform. Upload files, share text, or paste code — get a live link instantly. No signup required. Real-time sync, password protection, QR codes, and more.

## Company

- **Company:** Irfanz Solutions

- **Contact for:** Custom software projects, sponsorship inquiries, business partnerships.
- **Location:** Pakistan
- **Serving:** Worldwide

## Product

- **Product Name:** CloudForShare
- **Product Type:** File sharing / Live board / Pastebin alternative
- **Pricing:** Free forever
- **Account Required:** No (optional for advanced features)
- **Max File Size:** 50 MB per file
- **Max Files Per Upload:** 10
- **Storage:** Supabase (secure cloud storage)
- **URL:** https://cloudforshare.com

## Core Features

1. **Instant Upload** — Drag & drop files, get a share link in seconds
2. **No Signup Required** — Start sharing immediately
3. **Live Board** — Real-time text collaboration
4. **Text & Code Sharing** — Paste code with syntax support
5. **Password Protection** — Add password to any board
6. **Expiry Control** — 1 hour, 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, or never
7. **Download Limits** — Limit how many times a file can be downloaded
8. **QR Code Sharing** — Scan to download on any device
9. **Custom Links** — Create memorable URLs like /b/my-class
10. **PWA Installable** — Install as mobile app
11. **Dark Mode** — Automatic and manual toggle
12. **Real-time Sync** — Changes appear instantly on all devices
13. **Clipboard Paste** — Press Ctrl+V to upload images
14. **ZIP Download** — Download all files at once
15. **Search & Filter** — Find files by name or type

## How to Use CloudForShare

1. Visit https://cloudforshare.com
2. Type text, paste code, or drag & drop files
3. Set password, expiry, or custom link (optional)
4. Share the link — anyone can view instantly
5. Everyone sees the same content in real-time

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend:** React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Vite
- **Backend:** Supabase (PostgreSQL, Storage, Auth, Realtime)
- **SEO:** React Helmet Async, Schema.org structured data
- **Hosting:** Vercel
